CustomField.description: Key the form generates when a submission or row is first staged, so a retry, an autosave or a double click in the same session saves one record instead of duplicates. It is unique and an External ID, which the older ExternalId field is not, so saves can upsert by it. Once a record has an Id, saves go by Id and this field has no further effect. Records saved before this field existed get a value on their next save.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: System-generated key that prevents duplicate records when a form save is retried in the same session. Populated automatically by the form components; leave it alone.
CustomField.label: Unique Id
